name: Ambient
key_tendency: Modal and open: dorian or minor with added 9ths and maj7 colours, chords that change every 2 or more bars.
signature: No kick, no backbeat: time is felt, not stated
Slow pads with long attack and release
Sparse bells or music box with random gaps (degradeBy)
listen_for: The chords change every two bars and the bells drop notes at random, so the loop never quite repeats. Listen to the space: the reverb is part of the instrument.

parts.chords:
const chords = chord("<Dm9 G Em7 F^7>/2").voicing().s("gm_pad_warm")
  .attack(1).release(2).room(0.9).size(0.95).gain(0.3)

starter.arrange:
arrange(
  [8, stack(chords, fx)],
  [16, stack(chords, bass, lead, fx)],
  [8, stack(chords.lpf(900), lead.slow(2), fx)],
)
